notes:
Hierarchy (light): bold blue headings and bold #00647f focus carry the structure. Labels at #33478a sit above hint text at #565f89. Hint text is the dimmest tone, as intended.
Hierarchy (dark): headings #7aa2f7 and body #a9b1d6 are unchanged. Hint #7e87b2 is still clearly below body and now readable.
Status never rests on colour alone. Failure shows as `!` plus "Setup finished with failures; the lines marked ! failed". Other statuses carry `+`, `~`, `-`, `=` glyphs, and `[x] enabled` and `fixed` are text. Focus is marked by `❯` and bold, not hue alone.
Layout at 40x20 reflows without clipping or overlap.
Dark regression: only the hint tone differs from the other dark tones. I did not diff against a pre-change dark capture, so "keeps its look" is judged from the span values.
Optional preference only:
  - In the light review-failed frames the error path line has no `!` marker. Its text ("is not a JSON object") and the red tone state the failure, so I judge it fine.
  - In the 80x24 review frame the "Lines 1-15 of 19" footer sits directly above `❯ Apply` with no spacer row. This is identical in dark.
Not run: truecolor/256/16/NO_COLOR tiers, ASCII locale, and the 120x40 light variants. None were in scope.
